Act I

WREN. I don't want gulls. Go away!

A BOY. You are going to be sent back at the end of the

week. And good riddance.

WREN. I don't know anything about it. 5+2 nd

BOY. Is! (MUSIC IN.) WREN. Isn't!

BOY. Round and round the lighthouse goes! (He laughs and runs off. (MUSIC with the sound of waves as WREN is led on by MRS. HOLLOWAY and another

KEEPER.)

KEEPER. She came over on the morning ferry.

(MUSIC OUT, waves continue.)
